description: Hand-authored true-positive / false-positive / true-negative / false-negative boundary cases for SQL template review. Expected verdicts and reason codes are written here independently of the analyzer; the test harness compares kernel output against them. Authors: review team, not generated by sqlguard code.

cases.title: value parameter used in table position
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM ?

cases.title: value parameter used as ORDER BY sort key
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ?

cases.title: identifier slot bound to multi-token payload
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM ${tbl}

cases.title: identifier slot bound to a quoted identifier
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM ${tbl}

cases.title: sort column outside the per-table whitelist
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ${sort_col}

cases.title: keyword slot bound to a non-keyword payload
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ${sort_col} ${dir_kw}

cases.title: undeclared identifier slot
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ${evil_col}

cases.title: declared slot left unbound
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ${sort_col}

cases.title: table slot bound to a table outside the whitelist
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM ${tbl}

cases.title: stacked statement after semicolon
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = :id; DROP TABLE users

cases.title: subquery used in IN clause
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders)

cases.title: CTE / WITH query
cases.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT a FROM x

cases.title: parameterized equality predicate
cases.sql: SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = :id

cases.title: positional IN list with one array placeholder
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id IN (?)

cases.title: multiple scalar positional placeholders
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id IN (?, ?)

cases.title: ANY() array placeholder
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = ANY(:st)

cases.title: dynamic sort field and direction via declared slots
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY ${sort_col} ${dir_kw}

cases.title: qualified dynamic sort field with table alias
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = :uid ORDER BY o.${sort_col}

cases.title: dynamic table name via table slot and alias
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM ${tbl} t WHERE t.id = :id

cases.title: parameterized INSERT
cases.sql: INSERT INTO users (id, email, display_name, country, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

cases.title: parameterized UPDATE against whitelisted column
cases.sql: UPDATE orders SET status = :s WHERE id = :id

cases.title: parameterized DELETE with WHERE
cases.sql: DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = :id

cases.title: numbered and named placeholders mixed
cases.sql: SELECT $1 AS a, email FROM users WHERE country = @c LIMIT :lim

cases.title: single trailing semicolon is permitted
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = :id;

cases.title: placeholders embedded in a string literal stay inert
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'x@example.test :id ? $1 ${tbl}' AND id = :real

cases.title: doubled single quote is an escaped quote, not string end
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE display_name = 'O''Brien :x'

cases.title: placeholder text inside a line comment stays inert
cases.sql:
SELECT id FROM users -- :fake ? $1
WHERE id = :id

cases.title: placeholder text inside a block comment stays inert
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users /* @nope :also ? */ WHERE id = :id

cases.title: NULL is a legal scalar value binding
cases.sql: UPDATE users SET display_name = :n WHERE id = :id

cases.title: whitelisted quoted identifier is still a valid identifier
cases.sql: SELECT "id" FROM "orders" WHERE "id" = :id

cases.title: missing named parameter binding
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = :id

cases.title: array placeholder bound to a scalar
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id IN (?)

cases.title: empty array binding
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id IN (?)

cases.title: array containing a nested array element
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id IN (?)

cases.title: LIMIT bound to a negative integer
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users LIMIT :lim

cases.title: table outside the whitelist
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM secrets

cases.title: column outside the whitelist
cases.sql: SELECT password FROM users

cases.title: DELETE forbidden on audit_events by table policy
cases.sql: DELETE FROM audit_events WHERE id = :id

cases.title: unterminated string literal is a lexical failure
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE display_name = 'oops

cases.title: unterminated block comment is a lexical failure
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users /* never closed

cases.title: non-SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement
cases.sql: DROP TABLE users

cases.title: unused extra parameter binding warns but still accepts
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id = :id

cases.title: value placeholder on the left of a comparison is data (documented non-issue)
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE :min <= total_cents
cases.note: A bound value compared against a fixed column is a legitimate parameterized predicate, not identifier injection; documented in SECURITY.md.
